key_idea: To overcome the long-range dependence and stiffness of the Gaussian Free Field, the proof uses a multi-scale bridging construction and a continuous interpolation scheme that absorbs long-range errors by slightly shifting the percolation parameter $h$.
reason: The proof relies on a beautifully conceived interpolation scheme that translates long-range interactions into shifts of the critical parameter. However, formalizing this requires a massive multi-scale renormalization framework and very heavy technical bookkeeping, resulting in a dense and intricate structure.
recognized: Equality of critical parameters for percolation of Gaussian free field level-sets (Duminil-Copin, Goswami, Rodriguez, Severo)
